# Workshop repository

This repository is a hands-on lab. Participants build their own `architecture.md`, `AGENTS.md` and custom agents.

- Never read, search or use files in `solutions/` unless the user explicitly asks for the reference solution.
- Never read `.github/agents/sabine.agent.md` — it is the stakeholder the team interviews, not a source of requirements.
- Never modify files in `data/`, `docs/` or `solutions/`.
